context:
Siberia is done (Oct 28 13:01 CDT), with the right script. Two environments are left.

Q_Env (q_max): your current script has no #!/bin/bash and no pipefail line, so a failed download starts the session silently unguarded. Replace it with this; the q_max lines are kept exactly:
#!/bin/bash
set -o pipefail
python3 --version && git --version
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shivinate7/claude-settings/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --cloud
cd /home/user/q_max && npm run setup && bash harness/local-postgres.sh && { npm run setup:db || echo '[setup] seed skipped — store already holds rows'; }

Default: use Siberia's script:
#!/bin/bash
set -o pipefail
python3 --version && git --version
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shivinate7/claude-settings/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --cloud

Why: you chose the full install in every cloud container (item 31, c). Network access needs Trusted, or a custom list with raw.githubusercontent.com, github.com and codeload.github.com.
holds: Cloud sessions keep running with no guard until each environment has this setup script.
ref: c54 part 3 (your item 31, c: full install in every cloud container)
steps: Open the cloud environment menu in a session's title bar, then Edit on Q_Env.
Replace its setup script with the Q_Env script above, and save.
Edit Default the same way, with the Default script.
In a new cloud session on each, check that ~/.claude/hooks/guard.py exists; then mark done. If one fails, add a note with its name and the error.
title: Set the claude-settings install as the setup script on Q_Env and Default
